(PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE C M JOSHI) Learned counsel appearing for the appellant files memo, which reads as below:
"MEMO FOR WITHDRAWAL OF APPEAL Herein the Advocate for the Appellant is most respectfully submits as under:
The Appellant has not prosecute the above said Appeal because on the ground that the double Petition have been filed arising out of the same MVC NC:
2025:KHC-K:2226 Number.
The Appellant has filed the above Appeal by over sight.
The Hon'ble court may be permitted to withdraw the above said Appeal.
Kindly the above appeal may be dismissed as withdrawn.
In the interest of Justice and equity."
2. In view of the memo, the appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.

Sd/-
